picks.title: S2E41: Ibogaine Inquiries Part III: The Sacred Roots of Iboga
picks.summary: Long before ibogaine entered Western clinics and laboratories, the plant it comes from held a sacred place in Gabonese life. In Part III of Ibogaine Inquiries, we travel to Gabon to explore Bwiti, the spiritual tradition in which iboga is understood as a teacher, guide, and living presence.Gabonese practitioners and Bwiti initiates describe the preparation, community, music, mentorship, and lifelong practice that surround the medicine. They explain why Iboga cannot be separated from the larger body of knowledge developed around it. As Western interest continues to grow, this episode asks what
picks.reason: Explores sacred indigenous tradition and consciousness through iboga and Bwiti.

picks.title: The Mystery of the Resurrection Body | Studies with Stearman
picks.summary:
How will believers be raised? What kind of body will we receive? And how does Genesis connect to the resurrection?

In this fascinating study of 1 Corinthians 15, Gary explores Paul's famous illustration of the seed, revealing God's incredible plan for the resurrection of believers. Along the way, he connects the promise of our future glorified bodies with Genesis 3, Genesis 6, the corruption of humanity before the Flood, and Christ as the "Last Adam."
picks.reason: A theological study on resurrection bodies and biblical connections to mortality and hope.

picks.title: Why Young People Flood The Traditional Latin Mass: Archduke Eduard Habsburg
picks.summary:
Why are so many young people suddenly returning to the Traditional Latin Mass?



Michael Knowles sits down with Eduard Habsburg-Lothringen to discuss the surprising resurgence of the Traditional Latin Mass among younger generations.



From beauty, reverence, and tradition to modern dissatisfaction with secular culture, the two explore why ancient forms of worship are attracting new audiences in the modern world.



Is this simply nostalgia—or a deeper spiritual hunger emerging among young people today? And what does the revival of traditional Christianity say about the future of the West?
picks.reason: Discussion on traditional Latin Mass revival with some spiritual and cultural insights.
